'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**Russia's [[Gazprom]] announces that gas flows through the [[Nord Stream 1]] [[natural gas pipeline]] to Europe will not resume until [[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War|sanctions against Russia]] are lifted. [https://www.ft.com/content/2624cc0f-57b9-4142-8bc1-4141833a73dd (''Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Luding earthquake]]
**A magnitude 6.8 [[list of earthquakes in China|earthquake]] strikes [[Luding County]], [[Sichuan]], [[China]], killing at least 66 people and injuring at least 250 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/rescue-efforts-underway-china-earthquake-toll-rises-65-2022-09-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[September 2022 Afghanistan earthquake]]
**Ten people are killed and nine more injured during an [[list of earthquakes in Afghanistan|earthquake]] in eastern [[Afghanistan]]. [https://pajhwok.com/2022/09/05/8-reported-dead-as-quake-rocks-eastern-afghanistan/ (Pajhwok Afghan News)]
*[[2022 Pacific hurricane season]]
**Three people are killed after Tropical Storm Kay strengthens into a hurricane in [[Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/kay-strengthens-into-hurricane-off-mexicos-pacific-coast-after-killing-three-2022-09-05/ (Reuters)]
*A vehicle and [[train collision]] in [[Kunfehértó]], [[Hungary]], kills seven people and injures the train's driver. [https://www.timesunion.com/news/article/5-killed-after-train-collides-with-vehicle-in-17419829.php (''Times Union'')]
*One person is killed and nine others are missing after a floatplane crashes in the [[Puget Sound]] near [[Seattle]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/travel-seattle-puget-sound-plane-crashes-5885a38c9862960be0691feb8917852d (AP)]
*Six people are killed after a building collapses in [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-accidents-lagos-nigeria-586655c46afda83fc1a1354665a7a133 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Saskatchewan stabbings]]
**One of the suspects in yesterday's [[mass stabbing]] that killed ten people in [[Saskatchewan]] is found dead. The other suspect remains at large. [https://apnews.com/article/sports-canada-ap-top-news-saskatchewan-regina-edba29cc529dfd0239a176dce885856d (AP)]
*[[Ivan Safronov (1990)|Ivan Safronov]], a former Russian journalist, is sentenced to 22 years in prison on [[treason]] charges after being found guilty of disclosing "state secrets", which he alleged were open source. Safronov had been under detention since July 2020. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/russian-ex-journalist-safronov-gets-22-years-prison-treason-2022-09-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[July 2022 Conservative Party leadership election|2022 Conservative Party leadership election]]
**[[Liz Truss]] is elected [[Leader of the Conservative Party (UK)|Leader of the Conservative Party]] and will succeed [[Boris Johnson]] as [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom]] on 6 September. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-62068930 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Kenyan general election]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Kenya]] rules that [[William Ruto]] is the winner of the presidential election after facing court challenges over the results. [https://leadership.ng/breaking-kenya-supreme-court-upholds-william-rutos-victory/ (''Leadership'')]
